name: annotation-support-matrix
description: What excise commits to doing with each annotation subtype, per ISO 32000-1 §12.5.6 — and what it deliberately does not do.
whyThisExists: Annotation scope kept being argued from memory. An annotation's FUNCTION is mandatory and its APPEARANCE is optional (§12.5.5), so 'do we support X' has at least four independent answers — do we read it, do we preserve it across a save, do we draw it, and do we let the user act on it. Conflating those produced two mistakes already: judging Widget support by whether pixels appeared (they never do in a page-raster API — widgets are an interaction layer, which is why pdfium inks 0 on a widget that four other engines ink 6400 on), and treating 'no agreed artwork' as an excise defect rather than as the spec declining to specify (#1015).

dimensions.read: Parse the dictionary and expose its data. 'required' means the subtype-critical keys are reachable through the API.
dimensions.preserve: Survive an open→save round-trip unchanged. REQUIRED FOR EVERY SUBTYPE, including ones excise never draws — dropping a form field, a link action or an attachment on save is a data-loss defect no rendering test catches (#1017).
dimensions.display: appearance-stream = draw /AP when present, draw nothing when absent. synthesize = also generate an appearance when /AP is absent. never = do not draw inline at all.
dimensions.interact: none | navigate | fill. Executing JavaScript or Launch actions is NEVER supported — see notSupported below.
dimensions.redactionCarrier: Carries text or data that redaction must scrub. These live OUTSIDE the page content stream, so content-stream redaction alone does not reach them (#608, #467).
dimensions.verifiedBy: The gate or test that proves the display/preserve claim. null means the commitment is currently UNPROVEN — that is deliberate information, not an omission.

notSupported.executeJavaScriptActions: A /JavaScript action on a Link or Widget is NEVER executed. excise is used on sensitive documents; running script from an untrusted file is a security hole, not a feature.
notSupported.executeLaunchActions: /Launch (run an external program) is never executed, for the same reason.
notSupported.mediaPlayback: Sound, Movie and Screen are preserved and their /AP is drawn if present, but nothing is ever played.
notSupported.richMedia3D: /RichMedia, /3D and /Projection are preserved byte-for-byte and never interpreted or drawn. excise does not embed a 3D engine.
notSupported.annotationAuthoring: FROZEN 2026-08-16 by project decision. Authoring already shipped (v3.8.0, #912/#934); no further creation tooling. In scope is supporting annotations in the file, reading their data, and displaying the visual ones.
notSupported.popupWindowChrome: Popup annotations are recognised so they are NOT drawn inline, and their text belongs to the parent markup annotation. excise does not implement a floating note UI.

subtypes.note: Form fields. The largest non-visual use of annotations in the format — every AcroForm field's on-page presence is a Widget. Field VALUES are text, so this is a redaction carrier. Page-raster oracle APIs legitimately draw nothing here (pdfium's form-fill layer is a separate pass), which is why Widget rows are judged over 3 engines, not 5.
Navigation only: GoTo and URI. A /URI is user-visible text and travels with the file, so it is a carrier. §12.5.6.5 default 1pt border implemented in #987; the absurd-width case refuses per #1015.
The sticky-note icon. /Contents is the note body — real human text outside the content stream.
Text drawn directly on the page. Among the most important carriers: it LOOKS like page content but is not in the content stream.
Quad-based text markup. Magnitude divergence tracked as #1004.
Line endings are distinguishable and preserved in order across a save (#933).
Every point preserved in order across a save (#933).
Deliberately never drawn inline — it is the note window for its parent markup annotation, and its text belongs to that parent. Recognised precisely so it is NOT rendered onto the page.

Embeds an ENTIRE arbitrary file. The most consequential data carrier in the format — scrubbed by default in the GUI redaction-copy flow (#467). No synthesis: the oracles disagree on the icon and there is nothing to copy.

No synthesis, by decision #1015: 3 of 5 engines draw and disagree 4.7x on quantity and 3.6x on bbox height. A stamp's picture is viewer-specific art — there is nothing to copy, only an invitation to invent some.
No synthesis. #972's first fix drew a caret where a tick belonged, with identical pixel count and identical bbox — the case that proved an ink count and a bbox cannot discriminate shape.

§12.5.6.23. Marks a region INTENDED for redaction — an instruction to a processor, not a picture. excise recognises and preserves it; whether excise should ACT on it is an open product question, not a rendering one.
Preserved, never played. Embedded audio is a data carrier.
Preserved, never played.
Media playback surface. Preserved, never played, its action never executed.
Drawn from its /AP only.
Prepress. Not currently recognised by name in Excise.Core; preserved as an unknown subtype. Listed so the gap is visible rather than implicit.
Prepress. As PrinterMark.
Preserved byte-for-byte, never interpreted. excise does not embed a 3D engine.
As 3D.
